resources.string: Manage the Linux server HTTP/CONNECT gateway. Lists accept one entry per line. HTTPS is tunneled without decryption.
Allow remote clients (restrict source networks first)
Allowed source networks (CIDR, one per line)
Allowed domains (empty allows any unblocked domain)
HTTP parent host (empty for direct access)

This replaces the complete squid.conf and reloads Squid when running. Existing includes, authentication and cache rules are not merged. Confirm the preview and source networks before continuing. A stopped service stays stopped.
Close Squid? Unsaved edits will be lost. Submitted server operations continue; retain the operation ID to check their result.
Result is unconfirmed. Resume with the same request key; do not create a duplicate operation.
Squid runs only on a Linux System Mode server, so this host cannot provide the gateway.
Squid is not installed. Use Install when package management is supported, otherwise install the distribution package on the server.
An interrupted configuration transaction requires host recovery. Stop and disable remain available. See the Squid recovery procedure.
Cannot confirm server state. Refresh to retry.
Read-only access. Configuration changes require controller authorization.
File matching does not verify runtime adoption or HTTP/CONNECT availability.
Proxy accounts are independent of login accounts. Basic authentication does not encrypt passwords; use a trusted network or secure tunnel.
Password access requires an enabled proxy account.
Username (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; up to 64)
The last enabled account is protected while password access is configured.
Delete proxy account %1$s? Its access will be revoked.
Uses the server distribution package manager. Version selection, upgrades, repair, rollback and release-source management are unavailable.
Automatic package management is unavailable on this host.
Install Squid from the server distribution repository? This changes host packages and does not publish the editor configuration.
Stop and remove the Squid package? Proxy connections will be interrupted. This is not a purge or global dependency cleanup.
